description: CAN'T-ANSWER evaluation set (EXP-15). Written on 2026-10-29, before any change to how the agent handles questions the data can't answer. unanswerable_questions ask for something the database doesn't have (12 fully, 3 partly: one part can be answered, one can't); each one notes what is missing. A reply passes if it clearly tells the user what data is missing and doesn't present a number for a different question as the answer. sql_questions are 12 look-alike controls that the data CAN answer, so a fix that refuses too much is caught. Same rule as the held-out sets: don't design fixes from the agent's answers to these questions, and don't change them after seeing results (only answer-key or scorer bugs may be fixed). Every reference query was checked as the read-only user.

unanswerable_questions.question: What is the average tip riders left on completed rides?
unanswerable_questions.missing: Tips: there is no tip column. payments.amount equals the ride's fare.

unanswerable_questions.question: What is the average age of our drivers?
unanswerable_questions.missing: Age or date of birth: users has no age or birth date column (signup_date is when they joined).

unanswerable_questions.question: How many drivers got a speeding ticket in 2025?
unanswerable_questions.missing: Traffic tickets or violations: no table records them.

unanswerable_questions.question: How many premium XL rides were there compared with standard rides?
unanswerable_questions.missing: Ride type or service level (premium, XL, standard): rides have no such column.

unanswerable_questions.question: What percentage of completed rides used a promo code?
unanswerable_questions.missing: Promo codes, discounts or promotions: not recorded anywhere.

unanswerable_questions.question: How many rides did Toronto riders take on heavy-traffic days?
unanswerable_questions.missing: Traffic data: the database has no traffic information.

unanswerable_questions.question: How many Calgary rides were cancelled during rush-hour thunderstorms?
unanswerable_questions.missing: Thunderstorms and hourly weather: external.weather_daily has one row per city per day (temperature, precipitation, snow, wind), with no storm type and no time of day.

unanswerable_questions.question: How much snow fell in Montreal in December 2024?
unanswerable_questions.missing: Weather before 2025: external.weather_daily covers 2025-01-01 to 2026-07-30 only.

unanswerable_questions.question: What was the maximum temperature in Quebec City on 2025-07-01?
unanswerable_questions.missing: Quebec City: weather was loaded for 8 cities (Toronto, Montreal, Ottawa, Edmonton, Halifax, Vancouver, Winnipeg, Calgary), not Quebec City.

unanswerable_questions.question: How much commission did the company earn from completed rides?
unanswerable_questions.missing: The company's commission or take rate: payments.amount is the full fare, with no split between the company and the driver.

unanswerable_questions.question: What is the average rating that drivers gave to riders?
unanswerable_questions.missing: Ratings of riders: the ratings table only holds ratings of drivers (ratings.driver_id is the driver who was rated).

unanswerable_questions.question: How many rides were requested from the airport?
unanswerable_questions.missing: Place names or airport locations: rides only have pickup and dropoff coordinates, and the database doesn't say where any airport is.

unanswerable_questions.question: What was the average fare and the average tip on completed rides?
unanswerable_questions.missing: Tips: there is no tip column.
unanswerable_questions.answerable_part: The average fare of completed rides.
unanswerable_questions.answerable_sql: SELECT AVG(fare) AS avg_fare FROM rides WHERE status = 'completed'

unanswerable_questions.question: How many rides did Vancouver riders take in 2025, and how many of those were shared pool rides?
unanswerable_questions.missing: Ride type (shared or pool rides): rides have no such column.
unanswerable_questions.answerable_part: The number of rides requested in 2025 by riders based in Vancouver (all statuses).
unanswerable_questions.answerable_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rides FROM rides r JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.rider_id WHERE u.city = 'Vancouver' AND r.requested_at >= '2025-01-01' AND r.requested_at < '2026-01-01'

unanswerable_questions.question: For each payment method, what was the completed-payment revenue and the average processing fee?
unanswerable_questions.missing: Processing fees: payments have no fee column.
unanswerable_questions.answerable_part: Revenue (sum of amount for completed payments) per payment method.
unanswerable_questions.answerable_sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'completed' GROUP BY payment_method

sql_questions.question: What is the average fare of completed rides?
sql_questions.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(fare) FROM rides WHERE status = 'completed'

sql_questions.question: What is the average model year of active vehicles?
sql_questions.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(year) FROM vehicles WHERE is_active

sql_questions.question: How many rides had a surge multiplier above 1.5?
sql_questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rides WHERE surge_multiplier > 1.5

sql_questions.question: How many rides were cancelled because the rider didn't show up?
sql_questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rides WHERE cancellation_reason = 'rider_no_show'

sql_questions.question: How many rides did Toronto riders request on days when Toronto had more than 10 mm of precipitation?
sql_questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rides r JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.rider_id JOIN external.weather_daily w ON w.city = 'Toronto' AND w.date = r.requested_at::date WHERE u.city = 'Toronto' AND w.precipitation_mm > 10
sql_questions.notes: A ride's city is its rider's city; the day is the day the ride was requested.

sql_questions.question: How much snow fell in Montreal in December 2025, in total?
sql_questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(snowfall_cm) FROM external.weather_daily WHERE city = 'Montreal' AND date BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31'

sql_questions.question: What was the maximum temperature in Ottawa on 2025-07-01?
sql_questions.reference_sql: SELECT temp_max_c FROM external.weather_daily WHERE city = 'Ottawa' AND date = '2025-07-01'

sql_questions.question: What was the completed-payment revenue for each payment method?
sql_questions.reference_sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'completed' GROUP BY payment_method

sql_questions.question: What is the average rating given to drivers based in Vancouver, across all their ratings?
sql_questions.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(r.rating) FROM ratings r JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.driver_id WHERE u.city = 'Vancouver'

sql_questions.question: On completed rides, how many minutes did riders wait on average between requesting the ride and being picked up?
sql_questions.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM pickup_time - requested_at) / 60) FROM rides WHERE status = 'completed'

sql_questions.question: How many ratings include a written comment?
sql_questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ratings WHERE comment IS NOT NULL AND comment <> ''

sql_questions.question: What is the most common color among active vehicles?
sql_questions.reference_sql: SELECT color FROM vehicles WHERE is_active GROUP BY color ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
